verdict.rationale: Cua exposes programmatic surfaces (an SDK, a CLI, MCP, the cua-spacesd daemon), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair ask. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt and docs.md files are LLM-oriented documentation indexes, not API specifications, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
